editorial:
Imagine waking up every day feeling like something is deeply wrong, but you cannot quite put your finger on why. You follow a young guy who is totally messed up inside because of these scary, repeating nightmares. He is stuck in a loop of bad memories about a terrible event from his past that he cannot forget. The vibe is very heavy and moody, making you feel just as confused and anxious as the main character. It feels like a puzzle where you are trying to piece together his broken mind while he struggles to stay sane in a world that feels off.

What really works here is how the movie plays with your head. The acting feels real, and the slow build-up of tension keeps you guessing until the end. While it might feel a bit slow for some, the payoff is worth it if you like mysteries. If you are into psychological stories, you should definitely check this out. It is a great pick for a rainy weekend night.
endingExplained: The big twist reveals that the main character was not just having bad dreams. He was actually dealing with the guilt of a crime he committed. The nightmares were his mind trying to force him to remember the truth about the incident. In the end, he finally faces what he did, and the mystery clears up. He realizes he cannot run from his past, and the movie wraps up with him finally understanding the truth.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological mysteries and character studies.
